best_for_recent_DUI.general: 5-year lookback is standard; 10-year preferred for preferred rates

aggressive_vs_conservative.key_insight: F&G first for any impaired risk IUL case. MOO and Corebridge SIWL for manageable-health FE. Corebridge GIWL as last resort FE backstop.

easiest_simplified_issue.key_insight: GI products require zero health info — fastest, easiest placement for highest-risk clients.

best_for_older_clients.key_insight: MOO and American Amicable have strongest older-age FE coverage. NLG IUL goes to age 85 but requires full underwriting.

example_1.profile: 52-year-old, Type 2 diabetic 4 years, controlled A1C, smoker, wants permanent coverage with living benefits, $300/month budget

analysis.product_fit: IUL or Whole Life with Living Benefits
analysis.reasoning: T2 diabetic age 51-60: F&G is most favorable (Standard possible). Smoker: tobacco rates will apply. $300/month is solid IUL premium. Living benefits included.
analysis.secondary_option: Corebridge QoL Max Accumulator+ (if A1C well controlled and otherwise healthy)
analysis.avoid: MOO IUL / NLG for IUL if T2 diabetic — F&G is stronger fit
analysis.tobacco_note: All carriers will rate as tobacco. F&G still most flexible on combined diabetes + tobacco.

example_2.profile: Client had CHF 7 years ago, wants final expense

analysis.reasoning: CHF history = decline on all SIWL Level products (MOO, Foresters, Ethos). GIWL has NO health questions — CHF doesn't matter. Max $25K coverage.
analysis.secondary_option: F&G IUL (if client is younger and CHF is well managed — highly rated but may be approvable)
analysis.avoid: MOO Living Promise Level, Foresters PlanRight Level, Ethos Advantage — all will decline CHF

example_3.profile: 45-year-old cannabis user (2x/week recreational), clean health otherwise, wants whole life with living benefits

analysis.primary_recommendation: Foresters Live Well Plus or PlanRight
analysis.reasoning: Foresters treats casual cannabis use as NON-TOBACCO — saves client potentially $100+/month in premiums. Strong living benefits (chronic + critical + terminal).
analysis.avoid: Most other carriers will rate as tobacco smoker for cannabis users

example_4.profile: 38-year-old with Hepatitis C, otherwise healthy, wants IUL

analysis.reasoning: F&G is the ONLY carrier in the Eterna lineup that accepts Hepatitis B/C. All other carriers decline.
analysis.avoid: Submitting to any other carrier — automatic decline

example_5.profile: Client needs coverage today — healthy 28-year-old, wants term or IUL, needs issued this week

analysis.primary_recommendation: InstaBrain (fastest) or Ethos IUL / F&G ExecuDex
analysis.reasoning: All are instant/near-instant decision products for healthy younger adults. ExecuDex (F&G) is instant decision IUL for healthy clients 18-60.
analysis.avoid: NLG, Transamerica full UW — too slow

example_6.profile: 68-year-old with recent COPD diagnosis (no oxygen), wants final expense $15K

analysis.primary_recommendation: Mutual of Omaha Living Promise Level
analysis.reasoning: COPD without oxygen = MOO Level FE possible. Age 68 is in sweet spot (45-85). $15K well within coverage range.
analysis.graded_if_needed: Foresters or MOO Graded if recent COPD hospitalization
analysis.last_resort: Corebridge GIWL if no other carrier will approve
